 We head to the Czech Republic to face Slavia Prague in the fourth game of our Champions League campaign, and a familiar face was back training with the squad before the squad headed overseas. 
 After picking up a back injury during the World Cup, William Saliba is back training with his teammates again as he closes in on his first action since the semi-final against Spain in July.
 Having beaten Liverpool on Sunday to return to the top of the league, that would have only boosted the mood in the camp further before we head to Prague, and seven points from our first three matches in Europe this season put us in a strong position to qualify for the knockout stages
